# Leyframe

`material`

A composite of steel lattice bound with aethermite shards at an arcane forge, light and nearly unbending. The only material that carries a building to 163 floors; its aethermite forms only near ley lines.

> The top structural class: the tallest towers need steel, an arcane forge and the ley lines
